description: Every format (issue #70): Questions whose answers sit in the hard places of Word, PowerPoint, Excel, CSV, Markdown, plain-text, PDF, Transcript and Web page Documents (#155), in English and Chinese, run by `npm run eval` next to the gating set and reported per format, never gating (eval/README.md, "Every format"). A Web page names its HTML's path with `kind: "web"`: it is saved by its address, which the run serves from this computer, so it has no file kind.
hitRule: As the gating set's: a question is a hit if one of the top 5 retrieved Passages (a) belongs to expected.document, (b) covers expected.pages, and (c) contains expected.quote after both are normalised (src/shared/quoteMatch.ts findQuote).
pageNumbers: expected.pages are Unit numbers (src/shared/units.ts, ADR-0011), as Passages and Citations count them: a PDF's page, a deck's slide (its speaker notes included), a Word or Markdown file's sections in reading order (a Word file's footnotes are its last Unit), a spreadsheet's blocks of rows (the sheets after the first continue the count), a plain-text file's blocks of lines, a Transcript's blocks of cues, a Web page's sections in reading order.
places: Each question names the hard place its answer sits in: Word body, table-cell, footnote, section (only the heading says which), comment; PowerPoint slide-text, slide-table, chart (from its cached values), speaker-notes; Excel and CSV cell (a value in a sheet's first block, or a labelled value), row-with-header (a row in a later block, which repeats the header row), second-sheet; Markdown and plain text table, list, code-block; PDF table, two-columns, footnote, figure-caption, scanned; Transcript cue, across-cues (a sentence the speaker split over two cues), later-block (a cue in the second block of cues); Web page section (a paragraph under its heading), table-cell, list.
knownGap: A question with knownGap asks about text the readers don't index today (scanned pages with no text layer; Word comments were one until #76). It is asked and reported like any other, so the report shows the gap, and left out of the proposed bars. Its expected Location is where the text sits.

expected.quote: 需要提前借用社区活动室的桌椅。

questions.question: 重阳节那天食堂想办什么活动？

expected.quote: 重阳节那天我们想办一次长寿面活动

questions.question: When are the plots on the east bank of the allotment watered?

expected.quote: Plots on the east bank are watered on Tuesday and Friday evenings, between six and eight.

questions.question: Which allotment tank holds 1,200 litres?

expected.quote: North tank 1,200 litres 12 March 2027

questions.question: What should be done with the allotment's hoses before the frost?

expected.quote: Drain the hoses and store them in the tool shed.

questions.question: When does the museum's east gallery open on weekdays?

expected.quote: The east gallery opens at nine thirty on weekdays, half an hour before the main doors.

questions.question: When is the museum's reading room checked during closing?

expected.quote: Reading room Windows closed 17:45

questions.question: What should museum volunteers bring for counting visitors?

expected.quote: Bring the blue clipboard with the visitor tally sheet.

questions.question: 东侧菜地每周什么时候浇水？

expected.quote: 东侧菜地每周二和周五傍晚浇水，每次浇水不超过一小时。

questions.question: 北侧水箱的容量是多少？

expected.quote: 北侧水箱 1200升 2027年3月12日

questions.question: 入冬前水管要怎么处理？

expected.quote: 把水管收进工具房并排空积水。

questions.question: 图书馆少儿阅览区的灯几点打开？

expected.quote: 上午九点整打开少儿阅览区的灯，比大门开启时间早半小时。

questions.question: 闭馆时二层阅览室要检查什么？

expected.quote: 二层阅览室 窗户关闭 17:45

questions.question: 值班志愿者要带上什么统计表？

expected.quote: 带上蓝色夹板和读者统计表。

questions.question: Under the winter timetable, what time does the first sailing leave the north pier?

expected.quote: From 14 December the first sailing leaves the north pier at 07:10, and the last sailing returns to the terminal at 18:40.

questions.question: 冬季开放时间表里，第一班社区班车几点从北门开出？

expected.quote: 从十二月十四日开始，每天早上七点十分从北门开出的第一班社区班车直达图书馆，晚上六点四十分从图书馆返回的末班车停靠北门。
